title: PostgreSQL (s390x) Instance Parameters
description: Parameters for provisioning a PostgreSQL database instance on IBM Z / LinuxONE (s390x)

cluster_url.description: Target cluster server URL (optional, defaults to broker's cluster). Must be a registered ArgoCD cluster.

database_name.description: Name of the user database to create

database_user.description: Database user with full access to the user database (auto-generated if not provided)

database_password.description: Password for the database user (auto-generated if not provided)

superuser_password.description: PostgreSQL superuser (postgres) password (auto-generated if not provided)
